pages.title: Email Drafter (email-drafter) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Draft professional emails or notices from recipient, purpose, and key facts—covering follow-ups, requests, polite declines, and apologies. Input is a scenario brief plus facts; output includes subject, body, and a clear ask. Suited to admin, retail, and procurement outbound writing.

pages.title: Internal Comms Writer (internal-comms) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Write internal updates in common formats—status notes, weekly reports, FAQs, incident briefs, and leadership updates. Input is the comms type and fact list; output is a structured draft ready for review. Suited to teams that need consistent internal voice.

pages.title: Fact Checker (fact-checker) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Extract checkable claims from a draft, compare them to public authoritative sources for accuracy and staleness, and suggest sourced corrections. Input is the document to verify; output is a check report and optional revisions. Suited to final fact and tone review before delivery.

pages.title: Board Pre-Read Pack (board-pre-read) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Assemble a pre-meeting packet: TL;DR, metrics versus plan, progress and issues, board decisions needed, and risks. Input is key numbers and decision asks; output is a pre-read ready to circulate early. Suited to operating reviews and governance prep.

pages.title: Presentation Generator (ai-slides) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Generate a structured slide draft from an outline or source materials—conclusion-first openers, body sections, and appendix-style pages. Input is key points and length constraints; output is a slide structure ready for polish. Suited to briefings and presentation drafting.

pages.title: Deep Research (deep-research) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Frame a research question with multi-angle gathering and structured analysis, producing a scoped framework with sub-questions, success criteria, and a report skeleton. Input is the topic and constraints; output is a problem definition and research outline. Suited to kickoff and scope lock.

pages.title: Company Research (company-research) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Produce diligence-style notes on a company's business model, market position, leadership, and competitive landscape, with source-annotated materials and synthesis bullets. Input is company name and research purpose; output is a structured company brief. Suited to backgrounding before diligence or vendor selection.

pages.title: Competitive Analysis (competitive-analysis) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Systematically compare competing products on features, pricing, and positioning, producing comparison dimensions, an evidence table, and trade-off recommendations. Input is the set of options and constraints; output is a feature matrix with reasoned picks. Suited to selection, procurement, and market contrasts.

pages.title: Data Explorer (explore-data) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Profile a new table or file for shape, nulls, distributions, and suspicious values, producing a quality-issue list and suggested analysis dimensions. Input is a table name or CSV/Excel; output is an exploration report. Suited to pre-analysis grounding and metric-definition talks.

pages.title: Spreadsheet Merger (csv-excel-merger) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Merge, concatenate, or key-join multiple CSV/Excel files—mapping columns, normalizing keys, deduplicating, and validating row counts. Input is several sheets; output is a unified-schema result table plus a change log. Suited to the clean-and-normalize stage.

pages.title: Analysis Validator (validate-data) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Before sharing, re-check whether methods, calculations, and conclusions are supported by the data, producing a confidence assessment and improvement notes. Input is an analysis doc, SQL, or charts; output is a validation checklist. Suited to pre-delivery reconciliation of spreadsheet work.

pages.title: Data Analysis (data-analysis) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Run reviewable calculations, insight extraction, and basic visualization on Excel/CSV, with reproducible formulas or steps. Input is a dataset and analysis question; output is computed results and chart drafts. Suited to the analyze-and-compute stage.

pages.title: Dashboard Builder (build-dashboard) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Build a self-contained HTML dashboard with charts, filters, and tables that open in a browser for sharing. Input is metric descriptions and data; output is an openable dashboard file. Suited to presentation, verification, and reporting.

pages.title: Backward Design Unit Planner (backwards-design-unit-planner) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Follow Understanding by Design (UbD) from desired results outward to produce goals, assessment evidence, a learning-activity sequence, and alignment checks. Input is goals, grade band, and contact hours; output is a three-stage unit plan. Suited to lesson prep and training design.

pages.title: Retrieval Practice Generator (retrieval-practice-generator) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Generate recall questions across difficulties and formats using retrieval-practice principles, with answer keys and classroom tips. Input is topics, grade band, and item count; output is a practice set with explanations. Suited to designing practice and checks.

pages.title: Mind Map (mind-map) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Turn a topic, brainstorm, or document into a renderable Mermaid mind map with stated branch-organization principles. Input is a central theme and source material; output is map code plus a structure note. Suited to outlining knowledge frameworks.

pages.title: SQL Explainer & Writer (sql-query-explainer) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Explain, optimize, write, or document SQL in plain language for business readers—covering output shape and assumptions. Input is a query or a natural-language ask; output is an explanation, annotated query, or data dictionary. Suited to arranging learning materials with examples.

pages.title: Quiz Generator (quiz-generator) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Generate mixed-format, mixed-difficulty quizzes from learning objectives, with full answer keys and distractor notes. Input is objectives and coverage; output is items plus an answer key. Suited to building practice and self-checks.

pages.title: Engineering Research Notes (research) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: For an engineering question, search primary sources—official docs, source code, and specs—and write cited findings into repo Markdown. Input is the research question; output is a traceable notes file. Suited to product-research prep when engineering context matters.

pages.title: User Research Synthesis (Design) (research-synthesis) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Synthesize interviews, surveys, usability notes, or feedback into themes, insights, and recommended next steps. Input is research materials; output is patterns, segments, and prioritized follow-ups. Suited to analyzing research materials.

pages.title: Research Synthesis (Product) (synthesize-research) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Roll user-research findings into multi-evidence insights, hypotheses to test, and boundary notes. Input is already-organized clues; output is a conclusion pack plus open items. Suited to forming product-research conclusions.

pages.title: Idea Clarifier (idea-refine) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Clarify a fuzzy product idea into a problem statement, users, success metrics, and scope boundaries. Input is the raw idea; output is a reviewable problem-and-boundary brief. Suited to clarifying problem and scope.

pages.title: Conversation to Spec (to-spec) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Synthesize the current discussion and codebase context into a publishable specification and write it into the project's issue tracker. Input is existing conversation; output is a problem statement plus spec body. Suited to defining requirements documents.

pages.title: Spec to Tickets (to-tickets) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Split a specification into independently verifiable vertical-slice tickets sized for a single context window. Input is a spec; output is a schedulable ticket list. Suited to aligning acceptance criteria and decomposition.

pages.title: Frontend UI Engineering (frontend-ui-engineering) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Build accessible, responsive, production-feel user interfaces and components with design-system discipline and real interaction states. Input is UI requirements; output is component/page implementations. Suited to shipping UI after flows are mapped.

pages.title: Frontend Visual Design (frontend-design) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Propose distinctive visual direction, typography, and layout choices for new UI or redesigns—avoiding generic template aesthetics. Input is a brief and content theme; output is actionable visual guidance or code drafts. Suited to concept exploration and copy-ready layouts.

pages.title: Apple-Style UI Motion (apple-design) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Translate Apple fluid-UI and physical-motion principles to the web: instant feedback, interruptible springs, gestures, and depth materials. Input is an interaction scenario; output is design and implementation guidance. Suited to experience reviews and gesture-flow polish.

pages.title: UX Microcopy (ux-copy) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Write or review microcopy for buttons, errors, empty states, confirms, and onboarding—favoring clarity, brevity, and consistency. Input is scenarios and tone rules; output is usable copy drafts. Suited to tone agreements and consistency checks.

pages.title: Codebase Module Design (codebase-design) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Design interfaces and seams with “deep module” vocabulary: small interfaces that carry rich behavior, stay testable, and stay maintainable. Input is design intent; output is a module/seam proposal. Suited to design-and-decompose stages.

pages.title: Test-Driven Development (tdd) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Follow a red–green–refactor loop: write behavioral tests first, then the minimal implementation, with explicit seams and anti-patterns. Input is behavior descriptions and stack; output is executable TDD guidance and tests. Suited to implementation and bug-fix verification.

pages.title: Code Review (code-review) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Run a dual-axis review against a fixed baseline: does the change match repo conventions, and does it fulfill the spec/issue—summarizing findings in parallel. Input is baseline and diff; output is a paired report. Suited to review and delivery notes.

pages.title: Bug Diagnosis (diagnosing-bugs) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Drive hard-to-reproduce bugs and performance regressions with a tight feedback loop: establish a red signal first, then bisect and hypothesis-test. Input is the failure symptom; output is repro steps, evidence, and root cause. Suited to reproduce-and-locate work.

pages.title: Verify Before Claiming Done (verification-before-completion) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Before claiming done, passing, or merge-ready, require running verification commands and reading full output—evidence first. Input is the claimed status; output is a status note with evidence. Suited to regression and close-out checks.

pages.title: Ecommerce Growth Strategy (ecommerce-growth-strategy) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Diagnose ecommerce health with unit economics and growth levers—traffic, conversion, AOV, retention, and expansion—then outline an ~90-day priority roadmap. Input is category, platforms, and goals; output is a diagnosis and action plan. Suited to end-to-end marketing and operating curation.

pages.title: Grill Me (grill-me) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Stress-test plans and design assumptions with hard questions to surface gaps and unvalidated premises. Input is a plan or design draft; output is a pressure-question list and strengthening points. Suited to pressure-testing after clarifying problem and scope.

pages.title: Brainstorming (brainstorming) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Clarify intent, constraints, and success criteria before building—converge fuzzy goals into executable design premises. Input is the raw ask; output is clarified intent and boundaries. Suited to thinking clearly before implementation.

pages.title: Writing Plans (writing-plans) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Break a clarified spec into an actionable step-by-step plan. Input is a spec or requirement notes; output is ordered steps and checkpoints. Suited to plan decomposition after defining requirements.

pages.title: Systematic Debugging (systematic-debugging) · SkillPouch skill evidence
pages.description: Structured debugging: form hypotheses, gather evidence, bisect, and regress. Input is the failure symptom; output is an investigation log and root-cause conclusion. Suited to reproduce-and-locate work.
